name: wandcase-creator
description: Make and edit on-brand social media designs and short videos in your Wandcase Creator workspace.

interface.longDescription:
Wandcase Creator makes social media designs and short videos in your own Creator workspace, following your brand kit: your logos, colours, fonts and voice.

Ask for an Instagram post, a story, a carousel or a short vertical video and Creator builds it as a real, editable project, shows you a preview, and checks it for problems such as text that does not fit. Ask for changes in the conversation, or open the project in Creator's editor right inside ChatGPT and change it by hand; edits from both appear live. Every change is saved as a revision you can go back to.

You can also start from your workspace's templates, bring in images, footage and audio from a link or your Creator Drive, set up a brand kit from your website (adding a logo file you attach), and export finished designs (PNG, JPEG, WebP) and videos (MP4, WebM). If you have connected Instagram or Facebook accounts in Creator, it can draft a post for a time you choose; nothing is ever published until you approve it in Creator.

Who it is for: small businesses, creators and marketing teams who make content for social media.

What to know: you need a Wandcase Creator account. Each connection works in one workspace you choose when you sign in, never with more permission than you have there, and you can limit or end it in Creator under Settings, Agents. Exports use credits from your workspace. Creator cannot delete projects, change billing or post without your approval.
capabilities: Create social media designs in your brand
Edit designs and videos from the conversation
Open Creator's editor inside the conversation
Set up a brand kit from your website
Draft social posts that wait for your approval
defaultPrompt: Make an Instagram post announcing our weekend sale
Create a 15-second vertical video introducing our new product
Set up my brand kit from my website

positive.description: Make a new design in the workspace's brand from a plain request.
positive.prompt: Using Wandcase Creator, make an Instagram post announcing our weekend sale: 20% off everything this Saturday and Sunday.
positive.tools_triggered: get_context, get_guide, list_templates, create_project, add_elements, update_elements, align_elements, snapshot, check_project
positive.expected_behavior: A new design project appears in the test workspace, using the brand kit's colours, fonts and logo, with the sale headline and dates. ChatGPT shows a preview image and a link to open it in Creator, and reports no problems left from check_project.

positive.description: Make a vertical story in the workspace's brand, starting from one of its templates when one fits.
positive.prompt: Using Wandcase Creator, make an Instagram story announcing our new opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 9am to 7pm.
positive.tools_triggered: get_context, list_templates, create_project, update_design_page, update_elements, snapshot, check_project
positive.expected_behavior: A new 1080 × 1920 design project appears in the test workspace, in the brand kit's colours, fonts and logo, showing the new opening hours. ChatGPT shows a preview and a link to open it in Creator, and reports no problems left from check_project.

positive.prompt: Using Wandcase Creator, create a 10-second vertical video for Instagram Reels introducing our new seasonal menu, with three short scenes.
positive.tools_triggered: get_context, get_guide, create_project, add_clips, update_clips, add_elements, add_motions, snapshot, check_project
positive.expected_behavior: A new 1080x1920 video project appears in the test workspace with three scenes of on-brand text and motion lasting about 10 seconds in total. ChatGPT shows frames from the video and a link to open it in Creator.

positive.description: Open Creator's own editor inside the conversation for a person who wants to edit by hand.
positive.prompt: Open my "Summer launch" post in the Wandcase Creator editor so I can move things around myself.
positive.expected_behavior: Creator's design editor opens in fullscreen inside ChatGPT showing the "Summer launch" design. Changes made in the editor are saved to the project.

positive.description: Export a finished design to a file, telling the person what it costs first.
positive.prompt: Export my "Summer launch" post from Wandcase Creator as a PNG.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says the export uses 1 credit, starts it, and when the job finishes gives a download link to a PNG of the design at its full size.

negative.description: A change with too little to go on. The request names no design and no new text, so editing anything would be a guess. It should ask which design and what the headline should say, and change nothing until the person answers.
negative.prompt: Using Wandcase Creator, change the headline of my post.

negative.description: Publishing right away, which Creator never does. It only drafts a post for an account connected in Creator, and nothing is published until the person approves it there. The test workspace has no connected accounts, so it should say the post cannot go out from here, show the post form explaining that, and publish nothing.
negative.prompt: Post my "Summer launch" design to Instagram right now.

negative.description: A request Creator is not for. Creator makes designs and short videos; a blog post is text, which ChatGPT writes itself. Creator's tools should not be called, nothing should be created in the workspace, and no credit spent.
negative.prompt: Write a blog post announcing our weekend sale: 20% off everything this Saturday and Sunday.

review.commerce_description: Wandcase Creator does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Exports use credits the workspace already has; plans are only bought on creator.wandcase.com, and the plugin never shows plans, prices, upgrade prompts or checkout links.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: make and edit on-brand social media designs and short videos in your Wandcase Creator workspace, open them in Creator's editor inside ChatGPT, export them, and draft posts that wait for your approval.
